title: Birth in San Juan and voyage to New York
summary: Ramirez gives his full name, birth date (15 Sept 1913), his mother's death when he was three, and the freighter trip from Puerto Rico to Brooklyn to join relatives and his godmother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: ...nicknamed Ram, was born in San Juan, Puerto Rico...
The name was Juan Rogelio Ramirez.
Ah! What was the second one?
Oh yes, I see. On the 15th of September, 1913. Now, your mother died when you were three?
And how did you get to the States?
Well, my (?) relatives and their relatives sent for me and brought me over to the States.
You had a godmother here, did you?
Yeah, I had a godmother here.
You came by ship, of course.
Yes. The ship was the Ponce. I can remember that. That's not necessary, but...
That's right. It was a freighter!
Where did that come to in New York?
Brooklyn. The Puerto Rican Steamship Line. They had a line then.
Hosmaden(?), whose father owned the steamship, laundry...no, he owned a laundry company...
